type.ruling: Old Standard TT Bold UPPERCASE (+4) for titles and buttons: Victorian scientific instrument labels. Oswald 600 for numbers, Oswald for small labels, Old Standard TT for prose.

motion.gears: rotate the corner gears slowly (6 deg/s) while a panel is open - cheap clockwork life
motion.rewind: on undo / time effects, play panel_in backwards with a 0.3 s violet flash

pairs_with: hearts_bg (plum) or the kaleidoscope with col_a/col_b set to plum and violet.
